intro: The Costco Food Court is famous for one thing above all: the $1.50 hot dog combo, a quarter-pound all-beef hot dog with a 20-ounce drink, a price Costco has held for decades. Around it sits a tiny, cheap menu of pizza by the slice or whole, the cult-favorite Chicken Bake, a Chicken Caesar Salad, churros, sundaes and smoothies. Below is the full Costco Food Court menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: The Costco hot dog combo is $1.50 (a quarter-pound hot dog plus a 20 oz drink), a pizza slice is $1.99, and a whole 18-inch pizza is $9.95. The Chicken Bake is $3.99, a Chicken Caesar Salad is $6.99, and a churro is $1.49. The $1.50 hot dog is the icon. A hot dog with bun is about 580 calories.
hot_deal: Costco Food Court value: the whole menu is the deal, famously the $1.50 hot dog combo that has not changed price in decades. A whole 18-inch pizza at $9.95 feeds a family cheaper than almost anywhere, and most items are under $4. You generally need a Costco membership to order in the US. Prices barely vary by warehouse.

faqs.q: How much is the Costco hot dog?
faqs.a: The Costco hot dog combo is $1.50 and includes a quarter-pound all-beef hot dog plus a 20-ounce drink with free refills. Costco has famously held this price for decades, making it one of the best deals in food.

faqs.q: How much is a Costco pizza?
faqs.a: A slice is $1.99 and a whole 18-inch pizza (cheese or pepperoni) is $9.95, which feeds a family for less than most delivery chains. The slices are large, so a slice or two is a full meal.

faqs.q: What is the Chicken Bake at Costco?
faqs.a: The Chicken Bake is a rolled, baked pastry stuffed with chicken, bacon, cheese and Caesar dressing, a cult favorite at $3.99. It is filling, around 840 calories, and one of the most popular food court items after the hot dog.

faqs.q: Do you need a membership to eat at the Costco Food Court?
faqs.a: In the US, you generally need a Costco membership to buy from the food court, as most are inside the warehouse past the entrance. Some locations with outdoor-facing food courts have allowed non-members, but policies vary.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Costco food court items?
faqs.a: A hot dog with bun is about 580 calories, a cheese pizza slice around 710, the Chicken Bake about 840, and a churro 570. The Chicken Caesar Salad is about 710 and an ice cream sundae roughly 670.
